text: Sachin Talurkar scored his 108th International Century at the age of 38. Virat Kohli has just turned 38 and he is on 86.
So can he still get there? Let's do the math. He need 14 to equal Sachin and 15 to stand alone at 101. But he only plays one format now ODIs. No test, no T20s.
Across his career, Coley has scored an ODI 100 roughly once every six innings.

15 hundreds at the same rate means about 90 innings. India play around 20 odias a year, that 4.5 year. He would be 42 at 20-31 world cup, sounds impossible right? But here is the twist. Sachi needed 452 innings for 49 odia centuries. Kohli got to 50 in just 279.

So, the question is not whether he is good enough, it is whether time gives him enough games. Will Virat colleague get to 101? Yes or no? Tell me in the comments and follow for more stories like this.
